settings.title: Settings
settings.anchor_description: Choose when financial calculations begin. Earlier entries remain in your history but are excluded from indicators. The start date is included; its month may show partial totals.
settings.balance_hint: Balance immediately before the movements on the start date. May be positive, negative, or zero. This is not income.
settings.invoice_hint: Invoices are included by their payment or due date, even for older purchases. Enter the balance before those remaining payments. Balances include projected commitments.
settings.error: Could not save. Check the date and opening balance, then try again.
settings.refresh_failed: Settings were saved, but the indicators could not be updated. Reload the month or review pending recurrences.
settings.active_anchor: Indicators include financial movements from {date} onward.
settings.before_anchor: This month is before the starting point ({date}). Its history is available; indicators are outside the reporting period.
settings.partial_month: This month shows partial totals from the start date.

cards.title: Cards and invoices
cards.name: Card name
cards.archive_hint: History will remain available. New purchases will require an active card or explicit historical entry.
cards.includes_closing: Include purchases on the closing day
cards.rules_read_only: Recurring billing rules cannot be changed yet. Individual invoices can be corrected.
cards.no_cards: Register a card to organize its purchases and invoices.
cards.no_invoices: No invoices recorded for this card.
cards.no_entries: No purchases entered for this invoice.
cards.review_hint: Review the affected records before applying these changes.
cards.period_hint: Invoice navigation is independent of the timeline month.
cards.save_error: Could not save. Check the dates, card and invoice, then review the changes again.
cards.stale_error: Records changed since the preview. Refresh and review again.
cards.statement_hint: Completing purchase details preserves the total recorded from the statement.
cards.override_hint: You can select the actual invoice manually even when the purchase date is outside its suggested period.
cards.payment_hint: Confirm full payment of {amount} for the invoice closing on {closing}. Purchases retain their original dates.
cards.confirm_dates: Save these concrete dates for this invoice only.
cards.preview_hint: Calculated dates are suggestions; historical statement dates can be entered manually.
cards.date_correction: Correcting the purchase date preserves its invoice. Use association to move it explicitly.
cards.outside_period: Manually associated outside the invoice period
cards.closing_included: Purchases on the closing day are included.
cards.closing_excluded: Purchases on the closing day go to the next invoice.
cards.undo_payment_hint: Mark this invoice as unpaid again? Its cash flow will return to the due date and its payment event will be removed from the timeline. Purchase history is preserved.
cards.payment_error: Could not save the payment. Check the invoice is still current, reload if needed, and try again.
cards.payment_event_hint: Full invoice settlement. Purchases are not counted again.

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

profiles.create_description: A clear view of your finances starts here.
profiles.sign_in_description: Choose a profile to open your finances.
profiles.name: Name
profiles.language_hint: You can change the language later in the profile menu.
profiles.local_hint: Profiles on this device open without a password.
profiles.defaults_hint: Your categories and payment methods are set up automatically.
profiles.no_profiles_hint: Create a profile to start organizing your finances.
profiles.email_in_use: This email already belongs to a profile. Open that profile or use another email.
profiles.invalid_profile: Enter a name, valid email and supported language.

summary.load_error: Could not load {month}. Displayed data has not been updated.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.empty_hint: Add your first income or expense to see it on the timeline.
transactions.description: The reference date determines where this transaction appears on the timeline.
transactions.edit_description: Edit the transaction details. Category, payment method and settlement date are preserved.
transactions.name: Title
transactions.credit_hint: Select the card and review its invoice. Registering a purchase does not record invoice payment.
transactions.invalid_type: Please select a valid transaction type.
transactions.invalid_payment: Please select an available payment method.
transactions.invalid_date: Please select a valid reference date.
transactions.invalid_amount: Enter a positive amount with up to two decimal places.
transactions.save_error: Could not save the transaction. Check the fields and try again.
transactions.load_error: Could not load the transaction. Please try again.
transactions.remove_error: Could not remove the transaction. Please try again.
transactions.refresh_error: Could not refresh the timeline. Reload it to see the changes.

category_manager.title: Categories
category_manager.hint: Organize your entries with categories. Archived categories stay in your history.
category_manager.form_hint: Choose a name, icon, color and the entries this category supports.
category_manager.name: Name
category_manager.empty: No categories yet. Add a category to organize your entries.
category_manager.archive_hint: This category will no longer be available for new entries. Existing transactions keep their category.
category_manager.invalid_category: Enter a name of up to 100 characters, a valid color, icon and transaction type.
category_manager.duplicate_name: A category with this name already exists, including archived categories.
category_manager.category_not_found: This category is no longer available.
category_manager.refresh_error: Changes were saved, but the list could not be refreshed. Try again.
category_manager.incompatible: Choose another category for this transaction type.

recurrence.equivalents_hint: Estimated monthly equivalents · active rules only. Dated cash flow appears in the monthly summary.
recurrence.empty_month: No occurrences scheduled in this month.
recurrence.empty_rules: No recurrences yet. Add your salary, rent, or subscriptions.
recurrence.today_anchor: From today, {date}; independent of the selected month.
recurrence.unknown_coverage: Invoice coverage is unknown. Monthly amounts are unavailable until reconciled. Choose whether this purchase is already included in the authoritative invoice total.
recurrence.repair_hint: This occurrence needs review: check its category, payment, card and invoice associations.
recurrence.confirm_hint: Confirm the actual details. This creates a transaction and does not record payment or receipt.
recurrence.defaults_hint: Defaults apply only to unconfirmed occurrences. The original calendar and confirmed history remain intact.
recurrence.boundary_hint: Choose an occurrence on the original calendar. Confirmed transactions after this boundary are preserved for separate review; resuming leaves the paused gap empty.
recurrence.retained_preview: Retain projections through {date}; stop subsequent projections. All confirmed transactions are preserved, including those after this date.
recurrence.retry_refresh: Your change was saved. Reload the month and recurrence data; do not submit the occurrence again.
recurrence.save_error: Could not save. Review the fields, calendar date and current rule version, then try again.
recurrence.billing_unavailable: Invoice preview unavailable. Review the card billing policy or choose another method.
recurrence.first_removed: Projections stop from {date}. {count} confirmed transactions after the boundary are preserved:
recurrence.boundary_invalid: Choose a scheduled occurrence on the original calendar.
recurrence.invalid_amount: Enter a positive BRL amount in cents.
recurrence.invalid_input: Review the amount, associations and scheduled calendar date.
recurrence.conflict: This rule changed. Reload the month and reopen the editor.
recurrence.not_found: This rule or occurrence is no longer available.
recurrence.repair_required_error: Repair the rule or invoice coverage before continuing.

installments.intro: Plan a purchase across months, with an exact total and invoice preview.
installments.form_hint: Credit-card purchases, from 2 to 120 installments. A card is required. Saving records commitments, without recording payment.
installments.preview_hint: Review installment amounts, reference dates and invoices. No payment is recorded.
installments.historical: Allow archived cards for historical purchases
installments.invoice_mapping_hint: Automatic starts from the purchase date, then uses successive closing months. For legacy cards, select each existing invoice explicitly. Create or correct missing periods in Cards first.
installments.settlement_hint: These are recorded commitments. An elapsed schedule does not confirm payment. Card entries use invoice payment evidence; direct entries use their payment date. Recorded statement totals can differ from installment details.
installments.empty: No installment plans in this view.
installments.forecast_hint: Amounts by installment reference month. This is not invoice cash flow.
installments.progress: {scheduled}/{count} scheduled through this month · {paid} with recorded payment
installments.remove_hint: All installments will be removed. Calculated invoice totals will be updated; recorded statement totals will stay unchanged. This action cannot be undone.
installments.managed: Manage this purchase in Installments. Individual installments cannot be edited or removed.
installments.stale: Financial data changed. Preview the complete schedule again before saving.
installments.paid_error: A paid installment or invoice prevents removal of this plan.
installments.repair: This legacy plan has inconsistent data and needs review. Its entries have been preserved; plan changes and dependent overview totals are unavailable.
installments.request_conflict: This save request was already used or its plan was removed. Reopen the form to create a different purchase.
installments.invoice_error: Check the card and invoice mappings. Each installment needs a successive closing month; legacy or ambiguous periods must be selected or corrected explicitly.
installments.action_error: Unable to complete the action. Check the description, positive total, count, dates, category and payment method, then try again.
installments.load_error: Unable to load installment data. Try again.
installments.refresh_error: The plan was saved, but financial data could not be refreshed. Reload the view; do not create the purchase again.
installments.allocation_hint: Editing an amount splits the remaining total among the other unlocked installments. Lock an installment to preserve its amount during later edits. Preview changes again before saving.
installments.allocation_error: Keep every installment positive and the sum equal to the purchase total. Reduce the amount or unlock another installment to distribute the remainder.
installments.invoice_opening_dates: Use the first day of each invoice period from the second installment onward
installments.invoice_date_error: Each later invoice needs a known opening date after the preceding installment. Check invoice periods or turn off the invoice-opening-date option.
installments.credit_required: Installments require the credit payment method and a selected card.
